item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #VISPRSD
Issued at 03:22 PM 25 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Guimaras(NuevaValencia, Jordan, Buenavista), #Iloilo(Dumangas, BarotacNuevo, Zarraga, Mina) and #Leyte(Leyte) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Baco, Naujan, Victoria, Pola), #Guimaras(SanLorenzo, Sibunag), #Iloilo(Dingle, Pototan, Badiangan), #Cebu(Daanbantayan, Medellin), #Leyte(Capoocan, Carigara and Barugo) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
